content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(EDR-011 Anomalous Pre-Encryption File-Modification Burst Deviating from Host Baseline) AND ABIOC(EDR-011 Recovery-Inhibition Snapshot Deletion Deviating from Host Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations on the same host into a single pre-encryption-ransomware incident anchored to the enumeration -> mass-rewrite -> recovery-inhibition causality chain, catching the Akira encryptor before bulk encryption completes.
rules.name: Pre-Encryption Ransomware on Host — ABIOC Causality Stitch
